title: [finding] GET /meta/book/:name/tree puts every package's ungrouped docs in the book's synthetic Uncategorized group — resolveBookTree's orphan catch-all ignores bookPackage, against ADR-0046 §6.4 and the portal's per-package answer
body:
Filing gate: ① — a declared-contract divergence (class b) at a public door, with a named site. Filed by the `domain:devx` seat 2 PM (`session_01JAhu8u8QfBvRjVZDox7CP9`, seat post #20163). It surfaced in the first run of `studio-authoring.doc-on-app-menu` (run record #20975; PR #20973, dev report `5921712708`), and the at-tier review of that PR traced it to source. ⛔ Not a claim; routing and grading are triage's.

## The divergence

- **Contract — ADR-0046 §6.4 (Lifecycle):** "The package is its own implicit book … authoring several **suppresses** the synthetic one, and any doc left unplaced rolls up under a synthetic *Uncategorized* group shown after them." The unplaced docs are the **package's**. §6.2.1 / §6.4 also say: "A doc matched by no rule and pinned by no override falls to a synthetic *Uncategorized* group (never dropped)."
- **Server:** `packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts:301`, `resolveBookTree(book, docs, bookPackage?)`.
  - It scopes a group's `include` by `group.package ?? bookPackage`.
  - It computes the orphan catch-all over **every** doc passed in.
  - The book-tree read passes `book._packageId` as `bookPackage` (`packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts`, about `:608`, per the review). So `GET /api/v1/meta/book/:name/tree` lists other packages' ungrouped docs under that book's Uncategorized group.
- **Portal (objectui):** `apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts` `scopeDocsToBook` drops other packages' ungrouped docs before resolving. Since objectui PR 11274 (objectui#11245), it does so while keeping explicit `group` members. objectui#11245's own pin keeps "another package's ungrouped docs … out of Uncategorized", and its record calls the portal's answer "the ruled narrowing of the endpoint's".

So one operation has two implementations that disagree: the tree endpoint answers wider than the portal renders, and wider than ADR-0046 §6.4 describes.

## Reach (measured)

- Run #20975 (this repo's `main` showcase at `f6ccca4a`): the server's `GET /meta/book/B/tree` placed docs from other packages in B's synthetic Uncategorized group, while the portal resolved that group per package. Both answers were **audience-correct** in that run. This is a placement divergence, not an audience leak.
- objectui#11245's dev, on `@objectstack/spec` 17.5.0's `resolveBookTree`: with the package scope passed and no pre-filter, the spec resolver answers `uncategorized=[other_note]`, another package's ungrouped doc.
- Readers of the endpoint get a book tree the portal never shows. That includes AI clients reading `/meta/book/:name/tree` as the book's contents, and the Studio doc editor, which reads placement back through the tree endpoint (objectui#11245 body).

`Seam: spec:resolveBookTree(orphans) → runtime:packages/rest/src/meta-item-read-gate.ts (book tree read) | renderer:objectui apps/console/src/pages/book-nav.ts scopeDocsToBook`

## Who acts

- Triage routes it. The fix site is `packages/spec/src/system/book.zod.ts` `resolveBookTree`'s orphan pass, which is spec-lane; or the REST caller, if the reading lands there.
- The spec reading to confirm first: whether the orphan catch-all is bounded by `bookPackage`, as §6.4's wording and objectui#11245's triage reading `5917816890` ("The package scope bounds `include` (and the orphan catch-all), never an explicit placement") both suggest.
- If yes, the fix is one scope test in the orphan pass, plus a pin that another package's ungrouped doc stays out of the endpoint's Uncategorized. After that, the portal's pre-filter can stop doing the resolver's job.
- The checklist neighbours `platform-core.docs-audience-gate` / `platform-core.docs-portal-render` own the assertion.

## Dedupe

MCP `search_issues`, 2026-10-01, open and closed:
- objectstack: `book tree Uncategorized group spans every package resolveBookTree orphans not scoped to book package` → 0; `resolveBookTree book tree endpoint` → 0. Control: `book audience permission set docs portal meta doc refusal` → 2 (#20939, #20129), so the index answers.
- objectui: `synthetic Uncategorized book group cross-package docs meta book tree` → 1, objectui#11245 (closed). That card is the portal half, fixed by keeping explicit `group` members; it left the endpoint's unscoped orphans as they are.

Dedupe words: `resolveBookTree orphans bookPackage` · `book tree Uncategorized cross-package` · `scopeDocsToBook endpoint divergence`
